newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady in dull trade.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates held steady on Saturday in dull trading, but are expected to rise in the near term owing to demand from mill owners, dealers said.

"Trading remained dull today and buyers only went for select good quality stocks," dealer Kishan Chand said. "But we expect the demand from mill owners in the near term is likely to push the cotton prices up."
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was traded for 2,000 ($49.72) to 2,100 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) and the MNH-93 around 2,250 rupees, Chand said.
